Dujiangyan Luxury Suites at the Gateway to Qing Cheng Mountain

Dujiangyan, China

Breathe in the natural wonder and serenity of Six Senses Qing Cheng Mountain, nestled among the lush forests and slopes of the ancient spiritual centre of China. The resort offers a rare glimpse into the region’s halcyon past. An extensive range of onsite wellness treatments, dining options and concierge-organised experiences are available, as well as unrivalled access to some of the region’s most cherished historic and cultural sites. Visit the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Dujiangyan Irrigation System and the mountain itself, which is home to 11 famous sacred Taoist temples. You’ll be spoiled for choice, with four excellent restaurants - including traditional Thai favourites served with an incredible view at Sala Thai and authentic Sichuan and Cantonese dishes at Zi Qi Yuan Chinese Restaurant - and two bars. The resort also boasts an indoor heated pool, open year-round, and is less than a 10-minute drive from the stunning Dujiangyan Panda Valley, where visitors can see wild giant pandas and learn about the facility’s tireless efforts to preserve China’s iconic national treasures.
